structure: Single high school course. Header gives 'Grade/Course: Sociology / ACCN: CSD2300'. Pages are series of small tables: Strand ((name not shown)) + Standard heading: 'Standard N: ...'; per benchmark a table with Topic, benchmark text and code (Benchmark / SS.SOC.n.m in separate rows), Sample Performance (example task), 'Assessment (SPA)' and a 4-level Rubric (Advanced/Proficient/Partially Proficient/Novice in C1-C4). Rubric sentences sometimes split across page breaks.
